record_contract.fine_time: t_j=j/240 seconds, so observations cover [0,96) with t0=0 emitted before the first transition
record_contract.coarse_transform: y120[j]=y240[2j] exactly; no regeneration, interpolation, or filtering

generator_domain_and_psd_contract.pass_rule: minimum symmetric eigenvalue >= -1e-9 for each required covariance/noise matrix; tolerance is numerical-only and cannot redefine family semantics
generator_domain_and_psd_contract.failure_rule: A generator identity that violates an exact domain predicate or exceeds the numerical PSD tolerance is FROZEN_CONTRACT_VIOLATION before scientific evaluation.

channel_applicability.U: NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_ADMISSION; paired-rate sensitivity is descriptive only
channel_applicability.rule: Applicability is frozen before generation and cannot change from observed results.

rng_identity.family: NumPy Generator with PCG64DXSM bit generator
rng_identity.parent_digest_rule: SHA-256; digest bytes 0..7 unsigned big-endian; modulo (2^63-1); deterministic nonzero/unique retry
rng_identity.child_digest_rule: SHA-256; first 8 bytes unsigned big-endian; modulo (2^63-1); deterministic nonzero/collision retry

draw_order.continuous_C: Draw 2 standard normals for stationary latent x0. For each fine sample j in increasing order: draw 1 observation normal, emit y_j, then draw 2 process normals for the next transition.
draw_order.D_or_S_ARMA: From its assigned generator stream, draw total+2 Gaussian innovations in increasing array index, where total=fine_sample_count+5*240; discard exactly the five-second burn.
draw_order.AR1: Draw y0 from N(0,1); then one standard-normal innovation for each subsequent fine index.
draw_order.colored_memory: Use the domain-separated augmented stream: draw the stationary augmented initial state using the frozen covariance square-root rule, then draw the two-component colored innovation for each transition; there is no measurement-noise stream.
draw_order.two_mode_and_reference_mixture: Use the named domain-separated mode1/mode2/obs child streams only; no arithmetic seed offsets are permitted.
draw_order.piecewise_C: Use domain-separated process and observation streams continuously across the 48-s change point; no RNG reset and no latent-state reset.
draw_order.gain_control: F09 gains are deterministic transforms of the same realized C observation; no extra random draws.

rng_identity.environment_binding: NumPy version and complete dependency/environment identity must be frozen after packet APQ and before execution.

alias_certificate.scope: continuous C-lineage local damping/frequency coordinate under the frozen C generator and preserving observation class only
derivation: Continuous poles are lambda_±=-alpha ± i*nu, with sampled poles z_±=exp(lambda_±/fs)=rho*exp(±i*theta), rho=exp(-alpha/fs), theta=nu/fs.
For the frozen domain fn<=45 Hz and 0<chi<1, 0<nu<2*pi*45 rad/s. At fs=120 Hz, 0<theta<2*pi*45/120=3*pi/4<pi; the 240-Hz angle is smaller.
For positive-lag covariance, independent measurement noise contributes only at lag zero. With nonzero latent amplitude A, the sampled C law retains the nonreal conjugate pole pair.

A minimal nondegenerate second-order sampled recurrence therefore determines rho and the principal theta in (0,pi). Then alpha=-fs*log(rho), nu=fs*theta, omega_n=sqrt(alpha^2+nu^2), chi=alpha/omega_n, and fn=omega_n/(2*pi).

Any alias branch theta+2*pi*k is outside the frozen principal-angle/frequency domain. The same-path second rate supplies an additional consistency check rather than permission to widen the admissible class.
alias_certificate.pass: Independent analytic/reference verification confirms the stated sampled-pole conditions for the declared row and both rates.
alias_certificate.refuse: A distinct admissible continuous C lineage is analytically demonstrated to produce the same sampled-process law.
alias_certificate.need_more_info: The required certificate or minimal/nondegenerate recurrence premise cannot be established.
alias_certificate.claim_ceiling: No uniqueness claim is made outside the frozen C generator/observation class.

profile_I_contract.claim: resolution-bounded numerical uniqueness/interiority inside the imposed C family only
profile_I_contract.standardization: Use the frozen C1Q/C1Q-RS standardization and likelihood convention prospectively bound to the final implementation.
profile_I_contract.extra_evaluation_candidate: fitted chi may be evaluated to test profile/global-fit reproduction
profile_I_contract.prohibited_candidate: true chi is validation-only and must never enter the profile grid, starts, bracket/refinement selection, tie rule, or row label
profile_I_contract.objective: C1Q physical-coordinate profile likelihood using the same frozen C likelihood, fmin=1 Hz, fmax=45 Hz, burn_in_samples=128
starts: continuation from neighboring profiled chi when available
global fit projected to the current chi
six fixed source starts transformed at the current chi
profile_I_contract.refinement: Refine every finite base-grid local-minimum bracket and every endpoint-adjacent minimum with bounded scalar chi optimization; every scalar evaluation reoptimizes nuisance coordinates from the frozen start recipe.
profile_I_contract.nuisance_bound_rule: If the best candidate terminates on a nuisance bound, I=NEED_MORE_INFO.
profile_I_contract.no_finite_or_failed_refinement: I=NEED_MORE_INFO unless N already classifies the event as a numerical/search refusal

replicate_classification.row_retention: Every preassigned truth_id x replicate x rate row is emitted or represented by an explicit pre-evaluation frozen-contract failure record; no scientific or numerical failure is silently dropped.
composition: Retain the full vector of applicable channel states.
Attach every top-level refusal namespace for which at least one constituent required channel is REFUSE.
If any required channel is NEED_MORE_INFO, also attach NEED_MORE_INFO without deleting any refusal label.
QUALIFICATION_ELIGIBLE iff every required channel is PASS.
NOT_APPLICABLE channels are reported but never counted as PASS.
Numerical/search events are separately cross-tabulated even when they also cause N or I labels.
No precedence hierarchy may delete an overlapping refusal, unresolved state, or failure state.
replicate_classification.summaries: For each truth_id x rate_hz cell retain denominator 16 and independently report counts for eligibility, every refusal namespace, NEED_MORE_INFO, numerical/search events, multi-label combinations, and each channel state.
replicate_classification.Wilson_intervals: two-sided 95% Wilson intervals are descriptive only and never admission thresholds
